title: Happy Young Siblings at Fence, 1965 Outdoor B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A vintage black and white square snapshot photo taken on May 31, 1965, capturing two young siblings, Kirk (aged 3 1/2) and Lori (aged 2), playing near a vine-covered chain-link fence in a residential backyard. Kirk is perched atop the fence smiling happily, while Lori stands below facing the camera. The background features a suburban home, reflecting mid-century American domestic family life and childhood pastimes.
